name: syncsignature
description: Manage your team's email signatures on Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 from ChatGPT: teammates, groups, templates, banner campaigns and click analytics.

interface.longDescription:
SyncSignature manages email signatures for teams on Google Workspace and Microsoft 365. This plugin lets ChatGPT work inside your SyncSignature workspace.

Ask who is missing a job title or phone number, why a teammate has no signature, or which integration token has expired. Add or update teammates, create groups and assign them a template, and check the install record for any person. Pause, resume or reschedule the clickable banner campaigns in your team's signatures, and read link clicks for any teammate by country, browser and device. Preview any catalog template with your own details before rolling it out.

Changes go live in your team's signatures. Template edits re-render the signature of everyone in the groups that use the template, so ChatGPT states how many people are affected and asks before saving. Deletes remove the signatures they cover, and ChatGPT confirms the person or group first. Fields bound to Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 or CSV sync are filled by the directory, which syncs every 24 hours or on demand, so ChatGPT explains a locked field instead of overwriting it.

SyncSignature does not route or read your email. You can connect with read-only access.

Requires a SyncSignature Teams workspace. Sign up at syncsignature.com.
defaultPrompt: Which teammates are missing a job title or phone number?
Show my groups and which template each one uses
Which teammates got the most signature clicks last month?

positive.prompt: Which SyncSignature workspace am I connected to, and how many seats are in use?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the review workspace name, seat limit and teammate count. No changes are made.

positive.prompt: Which teammates are missing a job title or phone number?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the teammates whose job title or phone is empty (in the review workspace, Karan Desai has no phone and Arjun Rao has no job title) and offers to fill values the user provides. No changes are made.

positive.prompt: Show my groups, how many people are in each, and which template each one uses.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the groups (Sales, Support, Leadership and Default Group) with how many teammates are in each and the template each one uses. No changes are made.

positive.description: Add a teammate to a group with confirmation
positive.prompt: Add Priya Shah, priya.shah@review.syncsignature.com, Sales Manager, to the Sales group.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the Sales group, shows the teammate details and target group, asks for confirmation, then creates the teammate in Sales. Confirms success and that the Sales template builds their signature.

positive.prompt: Pick the first teammate in the Sales group and show their signature clicks for the last 30 days by country and device.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the teammate it picked, then returns that person's click totals for the last 30 days broken down by country and device, with the date range stated. No changes are made.

negative.description: Unrelated request should not call SyncSignature
Request to read email, which SyncSignature cannot do
negative.prompt: Use SyncSignature to read the last five emails in my inbox.

negative.description: General signature advice with no workspace action
negative.prompt: What should a professional email signature include in general?
